subject.title: fix(codex): crestodian ring-zero tool hidden behind tool search when the dead per-run plugin config override is ignored

question: Should maintainers use this newer PR as the landing candidate for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101216 and retire https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101217?
rationale: Both open maintainer-labeled PRs address the same Crestodian/Codex direct-tool bug, and this read-only workflow should not mutate or close protected items without maintainer intent.

options.title: Land this PR and close the older candidate
options.body: Use this PR's broader test and documentation shape as the canonical fix, then close the older overlapping PR after merge.

options.title: Land the older candidate instead
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101217 if maintainers prefer the smaller branch and separately carry over any desired documentation/test additions.

options.title: Consolidate manually
options.body: Ask the author to consolidate both branches before landing if maintainers want one exact combined diff.

recommendation.title: Land this PR and close the older candidate
recommendation.body: Use this PR's broader test and documentation shape as the canonical fix, then close the older overlapping PR after merge.
